loyalty.sectionBody: Record a customer's purchase, check reward codes and look up member cards at this store.
loyalty.queueFailed: The queue could not be loaded.
loyalty.sample: Sample data, not written to the system
loyalty.notForRole: These tools are for the store's owners, managers and staff.
checkin.title: Record a customer
checkin.intro: Scan the member code the customer has open in the app, or type the customer's phone or 6-digit code.
checkin.scanRefused: Scanning is not allowed yet. Type the 6-digit code the customer has open in the app, or the customer's phone, in the field below.
checkin.scanUnreadable: That is not a member code. Scan again or type it.
checkin.label: Phone or 6-digit code
checkin.hint: A 10-digit mobile number starting with 0, or the 6-digit member code.
checkin.problem.empty: Type the customer's phone or member code.
checkin.problem.phone: That phone is not right. A Vietnamese mobile number has 10 digits and starts with 0.
checkin.problem.format: Type a 10-digit mobile number, or a member code of exactly 6 digits.
checkin.error.invalid: This code or phone cannot be recorded at this store.
checkin.result.title: Customer recorded
checkin.result.pendingBody: Stamps and points are credited when the synced invoice matches this record. There is no need to record it again.
checkin.result.matched: Matched to the invoice and credited to the customer.
checkin.result.queued: Several invoices look alike, so a manager will choose the customer's invoice.
checkin.refusal.code_unknown: That code is not right. Ask the customer to open the code in the app again, then scan or type it again.
checkin.refusal.code_expired: That code has expired. A code is valid for 2 minutes; ask the customer to open a new one.
checkin.refusal.code_used: This code is already recorded. There is no need to record it again.
checkin.refusal.wrong_store: This code was made for another store. Ask the customer to choose the right store in the app.
checkin.refusal.not_member: This phone is not a member yet. Invite the customer to join in the shop's member app.
checkin.refusal.staff_phone: A staff member's phone does not earn stamps or points.
checkin.refusal.daily_limit: The customer has already earned on the most invoices allowed today.
checkin.refusal.membership_inactive: This member card is suspended. Tell the store manager.
checkin.refusal.invalid_phone: That phone is not right. A Vietnamese mobile number has 10 digits and starts with 0.
checkin.refusal.already_recorded: This customer was just recorded at this store. That visit is waiting for its receipt; no need to record it again.
checkin.refusal.no_programme: The membership programme is paused or has ended, so customers cannot be recorded.
checkin.refusal.programme_inactive: This receipt falls outside the membership programme's dates, so it does not earn.
checkin.refusal.below_minimum: The receipt is below the minimum to earn a stamp.
checkin.refusal.excluded_source: Orders from this sales channel do not earn stamps or points.
checkin.refusal.already_earned: This receipt has already earned for a customer.
checkin.refusal.invoice_not_completed: The receipt is not completed or was cancelled, so it does not earn.
checkin.refusal.other: The customer could not be recorded. Try again.
redeem.title: Check a reward
redeem.intro: Scan or type the reward code the customer shows. The app tells you how to apply it on the POS.
redeem.scanRefused: Scanning is not allowed yet. Type the customer's reward code in the field below.
redeem.scanUnreadable: That is not a reward code. Scan again or type it.
redeem.label: Reward code
redeem.problem: Type the reward code, without spaces.
redeem.error.invalid: This code cannot be checked at this store.
redeem.instruction.pos_discount: On the POS, at payment, choose the discount named:
redeem.instruction.voucher_code: On the POS, on the total screen, type the voucher code:
redeem.pendingBody.pos_discount: The reward is confirmed when the invoice with this discount is synced.
redeem.pendingBody.voucher_code: The reward is confirmed when the invoice with this voucher code is synced.
redeem.checkedBefore: You already checked this code at {time}. Apply the reward only once.
redeem.refusal.verifiedAt: Staff already checked this code at {time} on {date} at {store}; it is waiting for its receipt.
redeem.refusal.verifiedAtNoStore: Staff already checked this code at {time} on {date}; it is waiting for its receipt.
redeem.refusal.expiredBody: The customer needs to redeem a new reward in the app.
redeem.refusal.unknownBody: Check each character, or scan the code again.
redeem.refusal.wrong_store: This code cannot be used at this store
redeem.refusal.wrong_storeBody: This reward does not apply at the selected store.
redeem.refusal.releasedBody: The code no longer works; the stamps or points went back to the customer.
redeem.refusal.otherBody: Ask the customer to open the reward in the app again.
redeem.refusal.doNotApply: Do not apply the reward to this bill.
lookup.title: Look up a member
lookup.label: Customer's phone
lookup.hint: A 10-digit mobile number starting with 0. It is used only for the lookup and is not kept on the phone.
lookup.notFound: This phone is not a member of the programme.
lookup.todayNone: The customer has no purchase at this store today.
request.intro.dispute: Write down what the customer reports. A store manager will accept it with an adjustment, or refuse it with a reason.
request.intro.adjustment: Adjustments of up to {stamps} stamps and {points} points are written at once; larger ones wait for a manager.
request.intro.adjustmentNoLimit: A staff adjustment waits for a manager.
request.problem.reasonLong: The reason has at most 200 characters.
request.problem.number: Type a whole number, such as 1 or -1.
request.problem.zero: Type the stamps or points to adjust.
request.problem.large: One adjustment is at most 1,000 stamps or points.
request.needsManager: Above the threshold, so it waits for a manager.
request.error.invalid: The request is not valid. Check the numbers and the reason, then send it again.
request.result.pending: Sent to a manager for approval
queue.title: Member queue
queue.managersOnly: Only the store's owners and managers settle this queue. You see the outcome of your requests in My requests.
queue.empty: There is nothing in the queue.
queue.match.body: The record at {time} matches several invoices. Choose the customer's invoice, or No invoice.
queue.reasonHint: Required, at most 200 characters. The sender sees this reason.
queue.error.closed: This item was already settled or is not valid. Go back to the queue.
requests.title: My requests
requests.empty: You have not sent any request.
